descriptionChirho: The adjective 'arom describes the state of being without clothing, i.e., naked or nude. All four clusters carry the same semantic content with only grammatical inflection differences (masculine singular, masculine plural, feminine singular, conjunctive waw). Multilingual glosses consistently reflect a single meaning: Spanish 'desnudo/desnudos', Hindi 'nanga/nange/nangi' (gender/number inflection), Arabic 'uryanan/uraatan' (singular/plural), Korean 'beoseun chaero' (stripped state), and Swahili 'uchi/walio uchi'. The cluster S126080 ('naked ones') is substantival use of the same adjective, not a different sense.
